content.comment_body: Good afternoon, I need to assemble a hardware setup that supports 14 inputs and 10 outputs. Is it possible to use a [product_name] controller 230RC together with a [product_name] DM16 230R expansion module? Based on the documentation I found, only the DM8 module is shown connected directly to the controller. Is the use of a DM8 expansion module mandatory between the 230RC controller and the DM16 230R module? Do the controller and expansion module need to be the same [version_no]? Best regards, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. This forum communicates in English, so please write future posts in English. You can directly connect a DM16 230V expansion to the right side of a 230V base module. If you use a 0BA8 base module, then any DM16 230V module with an article number ending in 0BA2 is compatible.

analysis.insight_summary: The user requested clarification about compatibility between certain [company_name] base and expansion modules for hardware configuration, particularly regarding direct connection, the necessity of an intermediate module, and matching versions. Responses clarified that direct connection is possible and explained version and article number requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear guidance on whether a DM16 230R expansion module can be connected directly to a 230RC controller, if an intermediate DM8 module is needed, and whether module versions must match for correct operation.
